:::{#def-rate-ratio-patterns}
#### Rate ratio between covariate patterns

In a model for the [event rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/distributions.html#def-event-rate) $\lambda(\vx)$
as a function of the covariate pattern $\vx$,
the **rate ratio** comparing covariate pattern $\vx$
to covariate pattern $\vxs$ is

$$\rateratio(\vx : \vxs) \eqdef \frac{\lambda(\vx)}{\lambda(\vxs)}$$

:::
